Bedding supplies morning rules
The purpose of this section is to describe one way of working

Companion Animal Travel Desk

This section sets the daily standard for handling bedding supplies and related requests for companion animal travel. Staff should keep the work area orderly, check that approved bedding is clean and ready for use, and confirm that each passenger is given clear guidance in a calm and respectful way. When a traveler arrives with a pet, the coordinator should listen first, confirm the travel plan, and then explain the steps that support safe handling and smooth boarding.

If bedding is issued, it should match the pet's needs and the approved travel arrangement. Used items should be separated from clean stock at once, and any concern about wear, odor, or damage should be raised before the item is returned to service. The coordinator should also note any special care needs so the next handoff is consistent and courteous. <<FACT F095>> Plain communication matters most, because passengers rely on the desk for steady guidance and a reassuring tone.

If an incident is observed, staff should stay with the passenger as needed, report the matter through the usual channel, and keep the record clear and factual. <<FACT F108>> The coordinator should avoid speculation, speak only to what was seen, and share updates with the senior coordinator when follow-up is required. These steps help the desk protect animals, support travelers, and maintain trust in Aurelia Skyways service. For further help, contact the senior coordinator.
